grid.layout_notes: 6×3 that expands up to 6×6 via Collapsing Mine. Sheet: 64 ways expanding up to 46,656.

win_system.notes: 64 ways at 6×3 base; expands up to 46,656 ways as rows open to 6.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Collapsing Mine: winning symbols are paid and removed; symbols fall down; empty positions refill. Each collapse can open an additional row (up to 6). Collapses also from xBomb explosions or Wild Mining.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Starts with 3 active rows; each collapse activates one more row up to 6.

other.name: xBomb Wild
other.how_it_works: Substitutes except Bonus. Explodes removing adjacent symbols (except Bonus); +1 win multiplier for next collapse. Explodes on win (even if not in combo) before next collapse; also explodes with no win if Wild Mining not triggered. Does not explode when Wild Mining is triggered.

other.name: Wild Mining
other.how_it_works: Main game: 3/4/5 identical symbols align horizontally with no winning combo → award 1/2/3 wilds; other non-Bonus/non-Wild positions above the bar explode; triggers a new collapse.

wilds.name: xBomb Wild
wilds.behavior: Substitutes any symbol except Bonus. Explodes to remove adjacent non-Bonus symbols and increases win multiplier by +1 for the next collapse. Explodes before next collapse when there is a win (whether or not part of the win), or with no win if Wild Mining did not trigger. Skips explosion when Wild Mining triggers.

scatters.name: Bonus symbol
scatters.behavior: 3/4/5 Bonus symbols trigger Lucky Wagon Spins with 2/3/4 rows open initially.

multipliers.name: Collapse win multiplier
multipliers.behavior: Increased by +1 per xBomb explosion for the next collapse.

specials.name: Lucky Wagon coins / enhancers
specials.behavior: During Lucky Wagon Spins, coins land valued × active bet; top-row enhancers (Coin values, Multipliers, Dynamites, Bag, Chest, Dwarf) activate when a coin lands on the reel below.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on 6×3 (64 ways) Collapsing Mine: wins tumble and open rows up to 6×6 / 46,656 ways. xBomb Wilds explode to clear neighbors and +1 collapse multiplier. Wild Mining can spawn wilds from horizontal non-winning matches. 3–5 Bonus symbols start Lucky Wagon Spins (buyable at 60×/157×/500×).

phases.name: Spin (3 rows active)
phases.what_happens: Start with 3 active rows on 6 reels.

phases.name: Evaluate & collapse loop
phases.what_happens: Pay winning combinations; remove winners; tumble/refill. xBomb may explode (clear adjacents, +1 mult for next collapse). Wild Mining may fire if 3–5 matching symbols align horizontally with no win. Each collapse can activate +1 row up to 6.
phases.ends_when: No more wins, xBomb no-win explosions, or Wild Mining triggers exhausted
phases.state_changes: Rows may increase; collapse multiplier may rise

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 3/4/5 Bonus → Lucky Wagon Spins with 2/3/4 rows open initially.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Wins paid before each collapse removal; collapse multiplier from xBombs applies to subsequent collapse wins.
base_game_loop.notes: First NLC title with xBomb per sheet.

modes.name: Lucky Wagon Spins
modes.trigger: 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols (opens 2, 3, or 4 rows initially).
modes.spins_awarded: Starts with 3 spins; resets to 3 whenever a coin lands in the reel area.
modes.retrigger: Any coin landing resets spin counter to 3.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Initial open rows fixed by Bonus count (2/3/4). Top row shows enhancers each spin.
modes.progressive_state: Collected coin values (× active bet) accumulate; enhancers activate when coin lands under them.
modes.end_condition: Spin counter reaches 0 with no coin reset (or max win 60,000×).

phases.name: Enter
phases.what_happens: Open 2/3/4 rows from 3/4/5 Bonuses; set spins = 3.

phases.name: Spin / collect
phases.what_happens: Top row reveals enhancers; coins collect × bet; coin under enhancer activates it; coin reset spins to 3.

phases.name: End
phases.what_happens: When spins hit 0 without coin, pay collected values and return to base.

modes.effects: Hold-and-win style with 3-spin reset on coins; enhancer row; coin values × bet.

features.name: Collapsing Mine
features.trigger: Win, xBomb explosion, or Wild Mining
features.effects: Remove winners/exploded symbols; tumble; may open +1 row up to 6.

features.name: xBomb Wild Multiplier
features.effects: Wild except Bonus; explode adjacents; +1 win mult next collapse; explosion rules as above.

features.name: Wild Mining
features.trigger: 3/4/5 same symbol horizontal with no win
features.effects: Award 1/2/3 wilds; explode other non-Bonus/non-Wild above bar; new collapse. Suppresses xBomb explosion that step.

features.name: Nolimit Bonus (Feature Buy)
features.effects: Buy Lucky Wagon Spins with 3, 4, or 5 Bonus symbols.

options.name: Lucky Wagon Spins — 3 Bonus
options.effects: Trigger with 3 Bonus symbols (2 rows open initially).

options.name: Lucky Wagon Spins — 4 Bonus
options.effects: Trigger with 4 Bonus symbols (3 rows open initially).

options.name: Lucky Wagon Spins — 5 Bonus
options.effects: Trigger with 5 Bonus symbols (4 rows open initially).

numeric_limits.hit_frequency_notes: Hit frequency 25.98%; free spins 1 in 200; win 100× 1 in 1,009.

Game Features
Collapsing Mine
Each spin begins with 3 active rows and for each collapse,
an additional row becomes active, up to 6 rows. A new
collapse can be triggered by a winning combination,
xBomb Wild explosion or a Wild Mining feature.

Winning

## Collapsing Mine
Each spin begins with 3 active rows and for each collapse, an additional row becomes active, up to 6 rows. A new collapse can be triggered by a winning combination, xBomb Wild explosion or a Wild Mining feature.\nWinning symbols are paid out and removed before triggering the next collapse, which will, in turn, make all symbols fall downwards, leaving the empty position for new symbols to drop down to.

## Lucky Wagon Spins
3, 4 or 5 bonus symbols will trigger the Lucky Wagons Spins feature with 2, 3 or 4 rows of the reel area open initially. The feature starts with 3 spins and will reset to 3 spins every time a coin lands in the reel area. All coin values are valued times (x) the active bet.\nDuring the Lucky Wagon Spins feature, the top row will reveal enhancers for each spin - Coin values, Multipliers, Dynamites, Bag, Chest or the Dwarf. An enhancer is activated when a coin lands on the reel below the enhancer.
